_doc: Admin-panel checkJs errors, keyed file -> "<code>:<normalised message>" -> count. This list only shrinks: scripts/check-admin-types.mjs fails a new identity or a higher count, and fails a listed identity the source no longer produces until `node scripts/check-admin-types.mjs --update` removes it. Keys are file + code + normalised message, never a line, so an edit above an error does not churn the file. TS2304/TS2552 (undefined name) are pinned at zero.
